import copy,hashlib,json,os,tempfile,traceback
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
prefix=root/'docs/evidence/cdr-v59-tail-loaded-first-source-controls-terminal-20261028'
names=('imports','admission','restore','worker','result','outer','runtime','release')
saved={name:Path(str(prefix)+'.'+name+'.json').read_bytes()for name in names}
old_raw=Path(str(prefix)+'.workflow.yml').read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(old_raw).hexdigest()=='f0589ef60523d4f241ee0658d2334fd6e2b98fbe97cfeaa97cfeb3d81e020953'
new_raw=(root/'.github/workflow-templates/cdr-v59-tail-loaded-cloud.yml').read_bytes()
assert (root/'.github/workflows/cdr-v59-tail-loaded-cloud.yml').read_bytes()==new_raw
def extract(raw):
    lines=raw.decode().splitlines()
    i=lines.index('      - name: Admit all eight complete source-control records')
    assert lines[i+1:i+3]==['        run: |',"          python - <<'PY'"]
    stop=lines.index('          PY',i+3)
    assert all(line.startswith('          ')for line in lines[i+3:stop])
    return '\n'.join(line[10:]for line in lines[i+3:stop])
old=extract(old_raw);current=extract(new_raw)
report={'status':'RUNNING_AGGREGATE_SCHEMA_REGRESSION','positive':[],'refused':[]}
def execute(program,label,replace=None):
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='cdr-aggregate-schema-')as tmp:
        target=Path(tmp)/'hw/soc/out/cdr-v59-tail-loaded-controls'
        target.mkdir(parents=True)
        for name,raw in saved.items():(target/(name+'.json')).write_bytes(raw)
        if replace is not None:(target/'release.json').write_text(json.dumps(replace))
        try:
            os.chdir(tmp)
            exec(compile(program,label,'exec'),{})
        finally:os.chdir(root)
try:
    execute(old,'frozen-failed-aggregate')
except KeyError as error:
    assert error.args==('positive_cases',)
    frames=traceback.extract_tb(error.__traceback__)
    assert frames[-1].filename=='frozen-failed-aggregate'
    report['original_failure']={'error':repr(error),'frame':frames[-1].filename,'line':frames[-1].lineno}
else:raise AssertionError('Original aggregate failure did not recur')
execute(current,'corrected-aggregate')
report['positive'].append('All eight complete first hosted records accepted without rewriting any measured value')
release=json.loads(saved['release'])
mutations=[]
for key in ('existing_partial_assets_preserved','existing_release_not_recreated','new_release_uses_tested_sha','no_permissions_expanded'):
    value=copy.deepcopy(release);value['reservation'][key]=False;mutations.append((key,value))
value=copy.deepcopy(release);value['reservation']['rejected'].pop();mutations.append(('missing_seventeenth_refusal',value))
value=copy.deepcopy(release);value['reservation']['status']='PASS_INCOMPLETE';mutations.append(('wrong_reservation_status',value))
for label,value in mutations:
    try:execute(current,'corrected-aggregate',value)
    except AssertionError as error:
        frames=traceback.extract_tb(error.__traceback__)
        assert frames[-1].filename=='corrected-aggregate'
        report['refused'].append({'case':label,'frame':frames[-1].filename,'line':frames[-1].lineno})
    else:raise AssertionError('Bad reservation evidence accepted: '+label)
assert len(report['positive'])==1 and len(report['refused'])==6
report.update(status='PASS_ACTUAL_EIGHT_RECORD_AGGREGATE_SCHEMA_REGRESSION',
    old_program_sha256=hashlib.sha256(old.encode()).hexdigest(),
    corrected_program_sha256=hashlib.sha256(current.encode()).hexdigest(),
    exact_old_control_bytes={name:hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()for name,raw in saved.items()},
    simulator_or_archive_accessed=False,numerical_or_case_gates_changed=False)
print('CDR_TAIL_LOADED_AGGREGATE_SCHEMA_REGRESSION '+json.dumps(report,sort_keys=True),flush=True)
